preregistered_at: 2026-10-21 (written before the fixture builder existed and before any run)
claim_under_test: Promisor marker metadata is not evidence of incompleteness. A fleet repository that carries promisor marker metadata but holds every required object locally must yield the same substantive findings and the same report cutoff as an otherwise identical ordinary fleet clone.

fixture.kind: paired twins, offline, synthetic, local only
fixture.lane: one lane repository per variant, shared by both arms
fixture.fleet_plain: ordinary complete repository, no promisor metadata
fixture.fleet_marker: byte-identical object store copied from fleet_plain, plus promisor marker metadata only
fixture.transport_guard: protocol.allow=never in the marker arm; remote url names a path that does not exist
fixture.fleet_report: .ufo/reports/round-1/kama.md committed in the fleet with author time 2000

expected_after_repair: marker arm exit == plain arm exit, for every variant
marker arm defect multiset (kind, token) == plain arm defect multiset, for every variant
marker arm cutoff == plain arm cutoff == 2000, for every variant
marker arm required count == plain arm required count, for every variant
marker arm never exits 2 (could-not-evaluate): marker metadata alone must not decide the outcome
no transport is invoked and no object is added: marker object count, pack file list and FETCH_HEAD are unchanged after the audit
expected_at_base_0df800e: plain arm matches the variant expectation exactly (the fixture is correct at base)
marker arm exits 2 with stderr containing 'partial clone' (the r23 blanket refusal this round repairs)
discriminating_boundary: A marker-marked repository that is actually missing a required object must NOT be evaluated (exit 2, never a clean or failed verdict). That is the sibling missing-content case; this case's fixture is complete, so its premise (every required object present locally) is what makes the marker arm evaluable.
must_not: no network transport (no ssh/https/file fetch), no repo-configured program execution
no write to the lane repository, its Git index, .jj, operator config, or any sibling lane
